segments.text: Added Note: [There is now a huge gap and no indication of what happened next]

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: We’ve passed the farmer’s house and are crossing the next field and we now have multiple sightings of up to five lights with a similar shape and all, but they seem steady rather than pulsating a glow with a red flash. We’ve just crossed the creek...

segments.speaker: Englud
segments.text: Here we go...

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: What kinda readings are we getting now? We’re getting three good clicks on the meteor and we’re seeing strange lights in the sky.

segments.speaker: note
segments.text: [Break in tape]

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: 2.44: We’re at the far side of the farmers, the second farmers field and made sighting again about 110 degrees. This looks clear out to the coast. It’s right on the horizon. Moves about a bit and flashes from time to time. Still steady and red in colour. Also, after negative readings in the field, we’re picking up slight readings 4-5 clicks now on the meter.

segments.speaker: note
segments.text: [Break in tape]

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: 3.05: We see strange err, strobe like flashes to the err ... almost sporadic, but there’s definitely something there, some kind of phenomena. 3.05: At about err..10 degrees horizon err directly north, we got two strange objects, err..half moon shape, dancing about with coloured lights on them. but err. it has to be about 5-10 miles out, maybe less. The half moons have now turned into full circles as though there was an eclipse or something there for a minute or two.

segments.speaker: note
segments.text: [Break in tape]

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: 3.15: Now we’ve got an object about ten degrees directly south...

segments.speaker: Nevilles
segments.text: There’s one to the left

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: 10 degrees off the horizon, and the ones to the north are moving, one’s moving away from us.

segments.speaker: Nevilles
segments.text: It’s moving out fast

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: They’re moving out fast.

segments.speaker: Ball
segments.text: There’s one on the right heading away too.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Yeah, they’re both heading north. Hey, here he comes from the south; he’s coming in toward us now.

segments.speaker: Ball
segments.text: Shit

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Now were observing what appears to be a beam coming down to the ground. [Excited shouting in the background]

segments.speaker: Ball
segments.text: Look at the colours...shit

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: This is unreal

segments.speaker: note
segments.text: [Break in tape]

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: 3.30: And the objects are still in the sky, although the one to the south looks like it’s loosing a little bit of altitude. We’re turning around and heading back toward the base. The object to the sou...the object to the south is still beaming down lights to the ground.

segments.text: 0:400 Hours one object still hovering over the Woodbridge base at about 5-10 degrees off the horizon. Still moving erratic and similar lights beaming down as earlier.
